name: Submit and look up DocupletionForms forms with OpenAI chat agents

parameters.content:
## Submit and look up DocupletionForms forms with OpenAI chat agents

### Quick overview
This workflow uses an n8n chat trigger, an OpenAI chat model, and DocupletionForms tools so users can submit DocupletionForms form entries or look up existing submissions directly through a chat conversation.

### How it works
1. Receives an incoming message from the n8n chat trigger.
2. Uses an AI agent powered by the OpenAI chat model to interpret the user's request and extract any needed form details.
3. When the user asks to create a new entry, submits a DocupletionForms form with the extracted field values and returns an edit link.
4. When the user asks to review existing entries, lists submissions for the selected DocupletionForms form and returns the results in chat.

### Setup
1. Add an OpenAI API credential to the OpenAI Chat Model node (or replace it with another supported n8n chat model).
2. Install and enable the community node package `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` in your n8n instance.
3. Add your DocupletionForms API credentials to both DocupletionForms tool nodes.
4. Select the target DocupletionForms Form ID in each tool node (submit vs. list submissions) to match the form you want to manage via chat.

### Requirements
- n8n (Cloud or self-hosted) with `n8n-nodes-docupletionforms` installed
- A DocupletionForms account and API key
- An OpenAI API key (or another supported n8n Chat Model)

### Customization
- Attach more DocupletionForms tool instances (Generate Prefilled Link, List Document Sets, Download Merged Document) to expose more capabilities to the agent

## Receive chat request

Starts the workflow when a user sends a chat message, passing the request into the AI agent.

## AI form assistant

Uses an OpenAI chat model inside the AI Agent to interpret the user’s request and call DocupletionForms tools to submit a form or list submissions for a form.
